tech_stack.name: SigNoz Foundry (multi-container)
tech_stack.usage_context: Four+ containers: signoz-query-service (REST API + alert evaluation on :8080), signoz-ingester (OTLP HTTP :4318 + gRPC :4317), signoz-clickhouse (storage, :9000 native, :8123 HTTP), signoz-signoz (frontend+alertmanager :3301 host-map, UI). Combined image NOT used — brittle on ARM64 and hides component health.

tech_stack.name: Fluent Bit
tech_stack.usage_context: Docker container log shipper; tails /var/lib/docker/containers/*/*-json.log with docker parser, JSON field extraction (event/level/network/nick/channel), recursion guard (exclude Fluent Bit's own logs), OTLP HTTP output to signoz-ingester:4318.

tech_stack.name: Bridge otel-collector (signoz_bridge)
tech_stack.usage_context: Network-crossing OTLP proxy. Runs on BOTH ircfiber_net and ircfiber_logging. Receives OTLP traces+metrics from engine/gateway/holder on :4317/:4318. Hostmetrics + docker_stats receivers stay. filelog/containers receiver REMOVED (now Fluent Bit's job). filelog/caddy stays. Exports to signoz-ingester:4317 gRPC. Not used in local dev (engine pushes directly to signoz-ingester).

tech_stack.name: Grafana
tech_stack.usage_context: Cross-source dashboards; sole datasource changed to SigNoz query-service. Prod URL: http://signoz-signoz:8080 (internal Docker). Local URL: http://signoz:3301 (host-mapped). Port 8080 IS THE QUERY-SERVICE API, NOT ClickHouse.

tech_stack.name: D (LDC) — IRC Fiber engine/gateway
tech_stack.usage_context: OTel tracing (tracing.d) and metrics (observability.d) push OTLP HTTP to bridge collector on :4318/v1/traces and :4318/v1/metrics. In production, bridge proxies to signoz-ingester. In local dev, engine pushes directly to signoz-ingester:4318.

tech_stack.name: Ansible
tech_stack.usage_context: Logging role deploys Fluent Bit + SigNoz Foundry + Grafana; signoz_bridge role deploys network-crossing collector; caddy role manages /grafana/* and /signoz/* routes.

tech_stack.name: Docker Compose
tech_stack.usage_context: Local dev environment (deploy/local/docker-compose.yml) and test CI (docker-compose.test.yml). Local compose uses Foundry multi-container stack.

tech_stack.name: Caddy v2
tech_stack.usage_context: Reverse proxy for /grafana/* (Grafana) and /signoz/* + /api/v[1-5]/* (SigNoz); SIGNOZ-API-KEY injection via header_up. No Loki/Tempo routes remain after cleanup.

conventions: Two OTLP flows: (1) Engine traces+metrics via bridge otel-collector to signoz-ingester, (2) Container logs via Fluent Bit direct to signoz-ingester. Components never share a single OTLP hop.
Obs stack runs on ircfiber_logging Docker bridge. Bridge also attaches to ircfiber_net for cross-network OTLP proxy.
Grafana restricted to internal network — exposed ONLY via Caddy /grafana/* proxy.
SigNoz Foundry multi-container: separate query-service, ingester, clickhouse, frontend, alertmanager. Combined image NOT used.
SigNoz query-service API port is 8080 (internal Docker). Port 3301 is the host-mapped port. NEVER refer to 8080 as ClickHouse.
Fluent Bit OTLP output to signoz-ingester:4318 (direct, NOT via bridge). Docker socket mount for container log reading.
Fluent Bit JSON field extraction: engine log body parsed for event, level, network, nick, channel — preserved as OTLP log record attributes.
Fluent Bit recursion guard: Exclude_Path pattern to avoid reading Fluent Bit's own container logs.
No Kubernetes filter on Fluent Bit or bridge (bare Docker on VMs).
All services use restart: unless-stopped in production compose.
Named volumes for persistent data (ClickHouse, Redis, Mongo).

hard: Fluent Bit config must NOT produce infinite read-loop (recursion guard required: exclude Fluent Bit's own container logs).
Engine/gateway OTel endpoint in production resolves to bridge (ircfiber-otel-collector:4318). In local dev, resolves directly to signoz-ingester:4318.
Grafana datasource URL MUST target query-service API on port 8080 (internal Docker). Port 8080 is query-service, NOT ClickHouse.
Grafana datasource URL MUST use port 3301 only when accessed from host (local dev). Internal Docker URLs use port 8080.
Local Docker Compose uses Foundry multi-container stack. Combined signoz/signoz image is NOT used (ARM64 emulation overhead with ClickHouse bundling).
Old deploy/roles/signoz/ (ClickHouse config role) and deploy/test/signoz-config/ must be removed — superseded by Foundry.
Bridge otel-collector must have filelog/containers receiver stripped — Fluent Bit is the sole container-log shipper.
14 Loki alert rules must have SigNoz equivalents active before Loki removal (no monitoring gap).
ASCII-only in all config templates — no curly quotes, em-dashes, or Unicode lookalikes.
soft: Prefer SigNoz alert rules via REST API over provisioning YAML imports (simpler CI).
Prefer Fluent Bit OTLP output over Fluentd (lighter footprint, native OTLP).
Grafana dashboards that query Loki/Tempo/Prometheus will show no data after switch — manual migration is out of scope.
compatibility: SigNoz Foundry images support multi-arch (linux/amd64, linux/arm64) for most components. signoz-clickhouse may need explicit platform override on ARM64.
Fluent Bit latest official image (>= 2.2.0) includes OTLP output plugin.
Engine/gateway D code connects to collector via HTTP/1.1 OTLP (no gRPC).
Local compose must work on both ARM64 (Apple Silicon) and x86_64 (Linux CI).
Bridge otel-collector (otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.119.0) supports both gRPC and HTTP OTLP.
security_requirements: SIGNOZ-API-KEY is server-side only — Caddy injects via header_up; never in Fluent Bit config or browser-side code.
Fluent Bit tail input runs read-only (ro) on /var/lib/docker/containers — no write access.
Grafana auth proxy enabled (trusts X-WebAuth-User from Caddy) — no exposed Grafana host port.
Local compose SigNoz UI is localhost-only (no public exposure safeguard).
Old stack config dirs (loki, promtail, tempo, otelcol, prometheus) must be fully erased.
Old signoz role (ClickHouse config) and test dir must be fully removed.

patterns: Dual OTLP pipeline: traces+metrics via bridge, logs via Fluent Bit (separate OTLP hops to same signoz-ingester).
Foundry multi-container: SigNoz broken into 5+ specialized containers with independent healthchecks and resource limits.
Ansible-managed docker-compose stacks: logging role renders templates and deploys via community.docker.docker_compose_v2.
Grafana as cross-vendor UI: sole datasource is SigNoz query-service on port 8080 (internal).
Fluent Bit as lightweight log shipper + JSON field extractor: replaces Promtail AND the bridge's filelog/containers receiver.
Local dev mirror: deploy/local/ uses Foundry multi-container stack, same as production.

gotchas.text: CRITICAL: Port 8080 on SigNoz query-service is the REST API, NOT ClickHouse. ClickHouse native protocol is port 9000; HTTP is 8123. Every previous reference calling 8080 'ClickHouse port' is WRONG and must be corrected.

The signoz/signoz combined image bundles ClickHouse inside the same container as the collector/query-service/frontend. This is brittle on ARM64 (ClickHouse via Rosetta 2 emulation adds ~2GB memory overhead and is crash-prone). Use Foundry multi-container stack instead.

Bridge otel-collector currently has `filelog/containers` receiver (line 136) that tails ALL Docker container logs. Fluent Bit will duplicate these logs if the bridge receiver is not removed. Strip filelog/containers BEFORE or simultaneously with Fluent Bit deployment.
Fluent Bit OTLP output requires Fluent Bit >= 2.1.0 built with --enable-opentelemetry. The official fluent/fluent-bit:latest image supports it as of v2.2+.
Fluent Bit must exclude its own container logs (recursion guard). Without Exclude_Path, Fluent Bit reads its own output log files and re-ingests them, creating an infinite read-loop.

Engine OTel endpoint string 'http://ircfiber-otel-collector:4318' resolves to the bridge collector (which stays). In local dev, engines push directly to 'signoz-ingester:4318'. These are different endpoints — do NOT confuse.

The old deploy/roles/signoz/ role contains ClickHouse configs (keeper, ingester, query-service Prometheus config). This is SEPARATE from deploy/roles/signoz_bridge/ (OTel bridge). Only the former is removed.

Loki alert rules use LogQL count_over_time on structured event labels. SigNoz equivalent uses attribute.event = filter with threshold matchType. 1:1 translation is possible but evaluation frequency and window semantics differ slightly.
Grafana dashboards that query Loki/Tempo/Prometheus datasources will stop working after switch. Dashboards NOT migrated in this plan — manual rewrite required to query SigNoz.

Local Docker Compose with Foundry requires 8GB+ RAM host (ClickHouse ~4GB, query-service ~512MB, ingester ~256MB, IRC stack ~1GB, frontend/alertmanager ~256MB). On ARM64, signoz-clickhouse may need platform: linux/amd64 if native ARM images are unavailable.

prior_decisions.decision: Use Foundry multi-container stack (NOT signoz/signoz combined image) for both local and production
rationale: Combined image bundles ClickHouse in same container — brittle on ARM64 (Rosetta 2 emulation, crash-prone).
Foundry gives per-service healthchecks, resource limits, and independent restart capability.
Production already uses Foundry-style named services (signoz-query-service, signoz-ingester, signoz-clickhouse).
Foundry images are actively maintained and published for both amd64 and (mostly) arm64.

prior_decisions.decision: Retain bridge otel-collector (signoz_bridge) but strip filelog/containers receiver
rationale: Bridge provides network-crossing OTLP proxy between ircfiber_net (engine/gateway) and ircfiber_logging (SigNoz).
D services cannot directly reach signoz-ingester from ircfiber_net without the bridge's dual-network attachment.
filelog/containers becomes redundant with Fluent Bit — Fluent Bit is the sole container-log shipper.
Bridge keeps: OTLP receiver, hostmetrics, docker_stats, filelog/caddy, all processors.

prior_decisions.decision: Retain Grafana but switch datasource from Loki/Tempo/Prometheus to SigNoz query-service on port 8080
rationale: Port 8080 is the query-service HTTP API port (NOT ClickHouse). This was previously confused.
Grafana provides cross-source dashboards that the admin SPA's native SigNoz panel cannot render.
SigNoz 0.130+ query-service exposes a REST API on port 8080 that Grafana can query.
Grafana datasource URL differs by environment: signoz-signoz:8080 (prod Docker), signoz:3301 (local host).

prior_decisions.decision: Remove Tempo + Prometheus (user already decided — no design gate needed)
rationale: SigNoz stores traces natively (not just Tempo's trace_id index — full span data in ClickHouse).
SigNoz computes RED metrics from traces (replaces Tempo's metrics_generator + Prometheus scrape).
Engine pushes OTLP metrics directly — no Prometheus scrape target needed.
Removal is flat (no findings doc required). Merged into w2-t4 unified strip.

prior_decisions.decision: Fluent Bit replaces Promtail AND bridge's filelog/containers receiver
rationale: Fluent Bit is smaller (~30MB vs Promtail ~100MB).
Fluent Bit speaks native OTLP output — no intermediate format conversion.
Promtail only pushes to Loki; Fluent Bit pushes to SigNoz's signoz-ingester:4318.
Same log source (/var/lib/docker/containers/*/*-json.log), same docker parser.
Bridge filelog/containers becomes redundant once Fluent Bit is live.

prior_decisions.decision: Local Docker Compose in deploy/local/ with Foundry stack (not combined image)
rationale: One-command bring-up from source checkout — no external docker-compose repo.
Shares Containerfile + docker/ircd/Dockerfile with production.
Port mapping mirrors production: query-service on 8080 (internal)/3301 (host), ingester on 4318.
Foundry multi-container gives parity with production architecture.

prior_decisions.decision: Migrate Loki alert rules to SigNoz LOGS_BASED_ALERT with attribute.event = filters
rationale: SigNoz has a built-in alert evaluation engine (replaces Loki Ruler).
14 Loki rules all filter on event= labels — direct mapping to attribute.event = in SigNoz.
Fluent Bit JSON field extraction ensures event/level/network/nick/channel survive as OTLP attributes.
Thresholds and evaluation windows match 1:1 between Loki LogQL and SigNoz alert config.

prior_decisions.decision: Remove old deploy/roles/signoz/ and deploy/test/signoz-config/ directories
rationale: signoz/ role was ClickHouse config (keeper, ingester, query-service Prometheus) — superseded by Foundry.
signoz-test dir was ClickHouse config regression tests — no longer applicable with Foundry.
These cruft assets confuse future operators. Removal is safe after audit for playbook references.

learned_from_review.finding: Port 8080 is query-service API, NOT ClickHouse
learned_from_review.impact: ALL open_questions, quality_warnings, and port references in the first plan were wrong. Corrected throughout v2.

learned_from_review.finding: Bridge otel-collector already has filelog/containers receiver that overlaps with Fluent Bit
learned_from_review.impact: First plan assumed bridge was only for traces+metrics. Reality: bridge also ingests container logs via filelog/containers. Must strip this receiver to avoid duplicate ingestion.

learned_from_review.finding: SigNoz combined image is NOT suitable for ARM64 local dev
learned_from_review.impact: First plan assumed combined image. Review revealed Foundry multi-container stack is the correct architecture for both local and production. Combined image is brittle (ClickHouse emulation, opaque health, no per-service limits).

learned_from_review.finding: Old deploy/roles/signoz/ role exists separately from signoz_bridge
learned_from_review.impact: First plan missed this old ClickHouse config role. It must be removed to avoid confusion. Separate from signoz_bridge which stays.

learned_from_review.finding: Fluent Bit recursion guard (Exclude_Path) is mandatory
learned_from_review.impact: Without excluding its own logs, Fluent Bit creates an infinite read-loop — reading its own output as input, re-ingesting, growing log, repeat. This was absent from the first plan's Fluent Bit config.

learned_from_review.finding: Grafana datasource URL differs by environment
learned_from_review.impact: First plan used :3301 in all contexts. Reality: internal Docker networking uses :8080 (query-service). Only host-mapped Grafana uses :3301. Production Grafana (Docker) MUST use :8080.

learned_from_review.finding: Engine OTel endpoint differs between prod and local dev
learned_from_review.impact: Production: bridge (dual-network, ircfiber-otel-collector:4318). Local dev: direct to signoz-ingester:4318 (no bridge in local compose). First plan assumed same endpoint everywhere.
